name: What is a multi-height countertop?

acceptedAnswer.text: A multi-height countertop design features different sections of the counter at varying heights. This is often used to create distinct functional zones within a kitchen, such as a lower section for food preparation and a higher section for a breakfast bar or serving area. It can improve ergonomics by accommodating different tasks and users, and adds visual interest to the kitchen design. This approach allows for a more personalized and efficient workspace.
acceptedAnswer.description: A multi-height countertop has sections at different elevations, often for distinct functional zones like food prep and breakfast bars.
